script_text: Stop everything, Taurus! The cosmos has thrown you a curveball today that demands attention. Mercury in your 4th House creates a challenging square to Neptune, potentially causing family misunderstandings. Relationships: a conversation about shared finances reveals surprising value alignment. Single Taurus might find attraction brewing with someone from your professional circle. The Venus-Jupiter trine in your 10th House suggests unexpected recognition—don't be surprised if a superior notices your recent contributions. Avoid impulsive purchases today as Mercury-Neptune squares cloud your financial judgment—perfect time for creative brainstorming instead. Follow for tomorrow's reading to discover how the Full Moon in your opposite sign will shake up your relationships.
